label: Notebook
blurb: A paper notebook for todos and everything else: handwriting in Persian and English, pages that turn, a line through what is done, sketches, stickers, tabs by project, labelled with your Mystical and Orven project icons. Opens from the NOTEBOOK tab or with Alt+N. /note on Telegram writes a line into it.
